Method of Attack: Submitting a constant stream of spam posts to Spotify forums to inject tech support scam phone numbers into Google and Bing search results
Using Spotify forums that rank well in Google to trick unknowing callers into purchasing unnecessary services and software
Attack Vector: Spam posts on Spotify forums exploiting lack of email verification and bypassing reCAPTCHA
Indicators of Compromise: Indexed Spotify forum posts containing tech support scam phone numbers appearing in Google search results
Spotify forum posts with multiple spam posts every minute
Tweets by Cody Johnston (@AdwareHunter) reporting the issue
